description: Hair colour [HAIR-06] and the character-wide settings of the brow, lash, facial and body hair generators [HAIR-04], [HAIR-05]. Per-groom shape (guides, density and length maps, curl, clumping) lives in the document's grooms [DOC-08], not here.

defaults.provisional: The hair generators and shader are not written yet: the value is normalised to 0..1 and the default is a placeholder until they calibrate it.

parameters.description: Brown-black pigment in the hair fibres: high values give dark brown to black hair, low values blond.
Red-yellow pigment in the hair fibres: high values with little eumelanin give red hair, with more eumelanin auburn.
Share of unpigmented (grey and white) hairs mixed into all grooms; 0 has none, 1 is fully white.
Density of the body hair on chest, arms and legs; 0 is hairless.
Number of hairs in the eyebrows: low values give sparse, thin brows, high values thick, bushy ones.
Length of the eyebrow hairs; longer hairs stand out and look less groomed.
Height of the eyebrow band (bold, full brows above 0.5, thin ones below), with as many more or fewer hairs.
Length of the eyelashes, upper and lower.
How strongly the eyelashes curl upward away from the eye.
Number of eyelashes along the lid margins.
Thickens the eyelashes as mascara does (up to 2.5 times the bare fibre), so the lash line reads dark at a distance; 0 is bare lashes.
Density of short stubble over the beard area (cheeks, jaw, chin, upper lip, neck); 0 is clean-shaven.
Length of the stubble hairs, from a fresh shadow to a few days' growth.
Density of a full beard on cheeks, jaw and chin; 0 is none. Beard shape and length come from its groom.
Density of the moustache on the upper lip; 0 is none. Shape and length come from its groom.
